answer: Nodes secure identity via cryptographic attestation chains verifying zero-knowledge proofs of execution history. To thwart Sybil swarms, the protocol imposes exponential capital exhaustion: every new identity costs exponentially more stake ($O(k^N)$) across each cluster ridge. Staking tiers like violet tier validators burn non-refundable bond reserves like wild yarrow, rendering mass node replication economically unviable.
